rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The party reports that at its 都道府県連合幹事長会議 on 30 November the opening address was given by 土井たか子党首, who said the party would make a distinct, visible effort in the Diet debates.

locator.section: 冒頭あいさつに立った土井たか子党首は

rows.text: At the same meeting 伊藤幹事長 reported on the 土井党首就任 that took place under the emergency around the dissolution of the Diet, and on the executive arrangements since, and asked for approval; the meeting approved the secretary-general's report.
